title: The Incredibles, a super family.
lines: They look like an ordinary family.
A dad, a mum and three children.
She can make her arms really long.
As long as a garden hose.
And she can make a purple force field.
Nobody knows yet what he can do.
But superheroes aren't allowed to use their powers anymore.
So they pretend to be ordinary people.
One day Dad gets a secret message.
There's a robot on an island.
Only a hero can stop it.
Dad secretly puts on his old red suit.
An angry man, Syndrome, catches him.
She puts on her suit too.
She's going to rescue her husband.
Violet and Dash hide in the plane.
On the island they all have to use their powers.
Dash runs so fast that he runs across the water.
Violet makes a force field to protect her little brother.
Mum stretches out like a parachute.
Then Syndrome sends his giant robot to the big city.
The family flies to the city.
They make the robot use its own claw against itself.
Syndrome wants to steal the baby.
But then Jack-Jack discovers his powers!
He turns into fire, into a little monster, into metal.
Syndrome lets go of the baby.
The family stands together in the city.
At home they eat pizza together.
